settingsTabLayout.decision: Keep one vertical rail; introduce non-interactive group headings inside it.
invariants: All eight pre-existing tab `value` strings are unchanged; other code and tests reference them.
Each pre-existing trigger keeps its icon, label, classes and order within its group.
Headings are <div role="presentation">: not focusable, not in the tab order, not registered with Radix's roving focus. Arrowing the rail still visits exactly the tabs.
settingsTabLayout.why: The rail is vertical, w-44 and already `overflow-y-auto` (settings-dialog.tsx:652-712), so eight entries was never an overflow problem — it is a navigability one, and it gets worse with every lane that adds a tab. Grouping costs one 10px --muted-foreground label per group (four labels inside an already-scrolling container) and buys a structure that absorbs the next three additions without another layout decision. Per §6.4 the labels carry information — which subsystem a setting belongs to — so they are not chrome.

rejected.why: Defers the problem to whoever adds the tenth. The master brief pre-rejected it.
Breaks all eight existing tabs' layout and the rail's border-r, and buys a surface with less room, not more.

rejected.option: A search or command palette over settings
rejected.why: Discovery by search is worse than discovery by structure at eleven items, and it is new chrome that only pays off at a scale this dialog will not reach.

rejected.option: A second dialog for Runtime settings
rejected.why: Splits one mental model across two overlays and doubles §6.6's focus-trap and focus-restore obligations for no gain.

The closest alternative, and still wrong here: it hides items behind a disclosure the user must operate before they can see what exists. §6.5 bans hover-driven expansion; a click-driven one is permitted but costs a keystroke per group on every visit. With eleven items there is nothing to collapse for — the rail already scrolls.

costWidgetReconciliation.detail: web/src/components/session-cost-pill.tsx now re-exports SubscriptionBar under the name SessionCostPill with an identical prop shape, so the app shell's mount at web/src/app/page.tsx:1017 (not lane F8's file) needs no change and no second header trigger appears. Cost spent and subscription quota consumed are different quantities, so both are shown — as two sections of one overlay with one trigger, with the division of labour stated on screen.
costWidgetReconciliation.overlayChange: HoverCard -> Popover. A HoverCard's content is unreachable by keyboard and does not trap focus, close on Escape, or restore focus to its trigger; §6.6 requires all four.

quotaPosition.claim: Provider quota is NOT readable on this machine, and no code path in this lane can produce a percentage for one.
quotaPosition.evidence: server/src/agent/provider-auth.ts:31-63 states it in its own billingNote fields: openai-codex, github-copilot and xai each say Kady cannot read remaining quota or overages; anthropic is billingMode metered_oauth, which has no ceiling to be a percentage of (server/src/cost/billing.ts:72-74).
quotaPosition.orcaComparison: Orca's usedPercent does not come from its usage scanners either — claude/codex/opencode-usage-types.ts carry no limit field. It comes from src/shared/rate-limit-types.ts, populated per provider from an OAuth credential store or a CLI credential file (UsageRateLimitSource = oauth | cli | web | live-session). That source is closed to this lane twice over: it is Orca's Electron main/IPC layer, which decision D4 does not port, and reading a credential store is forbidden to this agent.
quotaPosition.rendering: Each provider's quota meter renders disabled with the provider's own sentence visible. The only real percentage on the surface is the project spend cap, which has a real denominator (server/src/cost/ledger.ts:695-719).

focusRestore.rule: §6.6 — an overlay restores focus to its trigger.
focusRestore.implementation: SettingsDialog is a controlled Dialog without a DialogTrigger. A layout-effect triggerRef records the opener (or querySelector('[aria-label="Open settings"]') as last resort). DialogContent.onCloseAutoFocus preventDefaults and focuses that node.
triggerOwners: web/src/app/page.tsx (same aria-label on the landing gear)
